checks: The exact parent bytes are pinned before compile/exec; only stdlib module initialization occurs.
Substitutions change only closed control paths and explicit clocks/limits. The parent timing, signal, drain, reap and persistence branches execute unchanged.
The only child consists of signal handlers, one exact READY line and signal.pause. It creates no children, reads no credentials and imports no application/native code.
One exclusive parent reservation and output directory enforce no retry. Normal current source/ledgers/configuration are not touched.
Expected actual is work cutoff at2s, INT then TERM after10s then KILL after15s, reaped -SIGKILL and exact stdout/receipt/completion readbacks. Total ceiling45s includes wrapper setup.
The test verifies one inert process without descendants; it does not claim resilience against an indefinitely stalled filesystem.
